value.answer: Lionel Messi, for me. Seven Ballon d'Ors, a World Cup with Argentina in 2022, and he kept producing at the top level for almost two decades. Cristiano Ronaldo has the numbers too, and plenty of people will argue for him, so it's a fair fight, but Messi edges it. I can't check the latest results or awards from here, so that's my take from what I already know.
